screen.dashboard.contract.2: Real status for each request; never marked done early
screen.dashboard.contract.3: Quick entry point to create a new request
screen.new_cleanup.contract.1: Pick a file and choose what to do in plain language
screen.new_cleanup.contract.2: Show a usage estimate before running, when available
screen.new_cleanup.contract.3: Advanced options stay collapsed by default
screen.upload_validation.contract.1: Check format, size and length before anything runs
screen.upload_validation.contract.2: State clearly why a file was rejected
screen.upload_validation.contract.3: Never pass a file whose properties could not be read
screen.project_detail.contract.1: Source files and every result, each linked back to its source
screen.project_detail.contract.3: The source file is always kept untouched
screen.image_workspace.contract.1: Select the area to clean up on the image
screen.image_workspace.contract.3: No real image processing at this stage
screen.video_workspace.contract.1: Select the area and the time range to clean up
screen.video_workspace.contract.3: Motion following and timeline repair come in a later stage
screen.rights.contract.1: Show the rights statement before any processing
screen.rights.contract.3: Record when and which statement version was confirmed
screen.provenance.contract.1: Show the file's original information before and after processing
screen.provenance.contract.2: State the limit plainly: only what is visible is processed
screen.provenance.contract.3: There is no option to strip the original information
screen.usage.contract.1: Usage counted in images and video minutes
screen.usage.contract.2: Previews do not count towards usage
screen.usage.contract.3: No real charging at this stage
screen.activity.contract.1: Log of the actions that matter
screen.activity.contract.2: Requests that were put on hold are logged too
screen.activity.contract.3: No sensitive content is written to the log
